reason: Provably equivalent: gap == 0 is unreachable at this line. The band is `max(0, tolerance)` so it is never negative, and the preceding guard only falls through when `abs(gap) > band` — which for a non-negative band means abs(gap) > 0, so gap != 0 on every input that reaches here. `>` and `>=` therefore agree everywhere reachable. The clamp exists for this reason and is itself pinned by two tests; see the argument in the source comment directly above the line.
